nodes.rationale: Document, paper, and image extraction is chunked and parallelized while code is handled by deterministic AST extraction.

nodes.label: Graph Health Gate
nodes.rationale: A read-only diagnostic surfaces dangling endpoints, self-loops, and collapsed edges without making a usable graph unavailable.

nodes.label: Folder Watcher
nodes.rationale: Code changes can be rebuilt without an LLM, while semantic content changes are deferred through an update flag.

nodes.label: Extraction Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence values prevent models from collapsing uncertain inferences into an uninformative default score.

nodes.label: Deterministic Full-Path Node IDs
nodes.rationale: Full repo-relative path stems and stable entity names avoid ghost duplicates across directories, chunks, and incremental rebuilds.

nodes.label: Cross-Repository Graph Merge
nodes.rationale: Per-repository extraction prevents shared intermediate output from being clobbered before origin-tagged graphs are merged.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Expansion may use only graph vocabulary, making cross-language and morphological matching auditable without inventing search terms.

nodes.label: Graph Work Memory
nodes.rationale: Saved outcomes, dead ends, and corrections bias future graph work toward useful sources and prevent repeated mistakes.

nodes.label: Corpus-Aware Whisper Prompt
nodes.rationale: God-node labels provide a domain hint that improves transcription terminology without requiring a separate API call.

nodes.label: Replace-on-Re-Extract Merge
